message.content:
A vertical magazine cover features a light blue textured background with red and black text. At the top, the large red word "TEMPO" is centered, flanked by smaller red numbers "55." Above this, text reads "Karpet Merah Teddy Indra Wijaya H.32" and "Uang Semir Dirjen Bea dan Cukai H.42."

The central figure is a man in a dark suit, light blue shirt, and blue tie, wearing a black songkok hat. He has pale skin, a rounded face, and squinted eyes. His right hand is cupped at the bottom while his left hand grips the base of a clear glass bottle held horizontally. Inside the bottle is a miniature cargo ship with a red and black hull, white deck, and red containers stacked on its deck.

To the right, large black text reads "KOMANDO BADAN EKSPOR." At the bottom right, white text states, "Presiden Prabowo membentuk badan baru yang akan memonopoli ekspor komoditas strategis. Penunjukan Danantara diwarnai tarik-menarik antarkementerian. H.54." A white barcode and QR code are in the bottom left corner.
